device.basis: DRAM controller of X-T20 2.11 section 5. 0xc8f09c reads the refresh-rate level from bits 8..10 of +0xec (caching it at 0xfdbea8 + 5) and, when it changes, rewrites the low half of the refresh words +0x9c and +0xa0 through 0xc8f044: 0xc30 below level 4, 0x618 at level 4; above level 4 it reports event 0x8015. A second controller at 0xfff0f000 is used only when 0xfda438 is set, which it is not in the s1-s3 captures. The boot code that programs the controller before the kernel is not modeled.
